mechanism_narrative: The sharp decline in WORKPLACES mobility at t-0w, coupled with a dip in RETAIL_REC, indicates a significant reduction in out-of-home activity that will persist, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than -19.9, or WORKPLACES mobility recovers significantly within the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden and substantial drop in WORKPLACES mobility, exceeding 20 percentage points week-on-week, signals a widespread shift to remote work or reduced public activity, directly suppressing retail and recreation visits for the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 20 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decrease or increases over the next 14 days following a >20 point drop in WORKPLACES mobility.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous sharp decline in TRANSIT station visits and increase in RESIDENTIAL time at t-0w indicates a strong preference for staying home, which will reduce discretionary retail and recreation trips, leading to lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than -19.9, despite TRANSIT falling and RESIDENTIAL rising concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: The abrupt and significant drop in WORKPLACES mobility combined with a rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility suggests the implementation of new, unannounced restrictions or advisories, which will depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as people comply.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than -19.9, or official announcements confirm no new restrictions were implemented.

mechanism_narrative: Despite the t-0w dip, the preceding upward trend in RETAIL_REC and sustained high GROCERY_PHARM mobility suggest underlying consumer confidence and essential activity, indicating a quick rebound for RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mobility at t+1w is lower than -18.4, failing to show a rebound from the t-0w dip.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained PARKS mobility above -20% baseline, even amidst other declines, indicates a continued desire for outdoor recreation. This activity will spill over into nearby retail and recreation, driving a modest increase in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility falls below -20% for two consecutive weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: If the sharp drops in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT at t-0w were due to a temporary event, a swift rebound in both, coupled with a decrease in RESIDENTIAL mobility, will signal a return to normal routines and drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: WORKPLACES or TRANSIT do not rebound as specified, or RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than -19.9.

mechanism_narrative: The recent increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility, combined with the dip in RETAIL_REC, suggests a sustained shift towards home-based activities and reduced discretionary spending, which will keep RETAIL_REC suppressed over the next four weeks.
